candidates.text: Corrosion test: the retro-reflector, or the lamp since the device is combined with a light, shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to saline mist for 50 hours, comprising two 24-hour exposure periods separated by a 2-hour interval during which the sample is allowed to dry.

candidates.text: Resistance to fuels: when the outer surface of the retro-reflector, in particular the illuminating surface, is lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a mixture of 70 vol. per cent n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent toluol, the surface inspected visually after about five minutes shall not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks are not objected to.
